passages.body: Antibiotics target bacteria and do not treat viral infections.
The assertion that antibiotics cure viral infections is false. A viral infection does not respond to antibacterial treatment.

Reference counting frees an object when its strong reference count reaches zero. Cycles require additional handling.
A resting dough hydrates flour before kneading.
A lease grants access until a deadline, after which the holder must renew it or stop using the resource.
A worker must stop acting as owner after its lease expires even if it cannot reach the coordinator.
A bounded lease lifetime prevents a disconnected owner from keeping ownership forever.
A DNS TTL limits how long a resolver may reuse a cached record.
After a DNS record changes, cached answers can persist until their TTL expires.
Reducing the TTL before a DNS migration shortens the stale-answer window but increases queries.
Waterlogged soil leaves little oxygen around roots and can damage them.
Drainage removes excess water and restores air spaces needed by plant roots.
A pot with blocked drainage can suffocate roots even when the leaves appear to need water.
Practicing retrieval on separate days improves delayed recall compared with massed repetition.
Spacing study sessions creates repeated opportunities to retrieve material after some forgetting.
Reviewing a concept at increasing intervals exercises long-term recall rather than only immediate familiarity.
Water boils when its vapor pressure equals ambient pressure.
Lower air pressure at altitude allows water to boil at a lower temperature.
A pressure cooker raises pressure, raising the boiling temperature of water.
A checksum calculated before transmission can be compared with one calculated after receipt to detect changed bytes.
Matching an expected cryptographic digest helps detect a corrupted downloaded artifact.
A changed file normally produces a different cryptographic digest; verify against a trusted expected digest.
Write the recovery log durably before flushing changed data pages.
After a crash, committed log records can redo changes not yet present in data files.
A write-ahead log preserves enough ordered information to recover interrupted database writes.
A token bucket admits a request only when a token is available.
Tokens refill at a fixed rate and unused tokens accumulate up to a capacity, permitting bounded bursts.
Token bucket capacity limits burst size while refill rate limits sustained request throughput.
Increase resistance or volume progressively rather than keeping the same easy load indefinitely.
Training adaptations require gradually increasing the challenge as the body becomes accustomed to a workload.
Progressive overload combines manageable increases in training demand with adequate recovery.
A light ray changes direction when entering a medium with a different refractive index at an angle.
Refraction explains why a submerged object appears displaced when viewed from air.
Snell law relates incident and refracted angles to the refractive indices of the media.
A sourdough starter contains yeasts and bacteria that ferment flour and water.
Yeast in the starter produces gas that helps dough rise while bacteria contribute acidity.
Regular feeding supplies flour carbohydrates that sustain the starter culture.
Permeable paving lets rainwater infiltrate instead of immediately flowing into drains.
Replacing sealed surfaces with permeable materials can reduce stormwater runoff.
Infiltration capacity matters: saturated ground may produce runoff even beneath permeable paving.
A transaction under snapshot isolation reads a consistent snapshot of committed data.
Concurrent transactions can read older versions without blocking each other under snapshot isolation.
Snapshot isolation does not by itself prevent write skew when transactions update different rows based on a shared condition.
Placing a toothbrush beside medication can serve as a consistent reminder cue for the intended routine.
Repeating an action after a stable cue helps associate the context with the action.
A recurring contextual cue reduces the need to decide anew when to begin a habit.
Lossless compression exploits predictable redundancy while preserving exact reconstruction.
Random-looking data with little exploitable structure is generally difficult to compress losslessly.
A decoder reconstructs the exact original bytes from a valid losslessly compressed representation.
Plant roots help bind soil and reduce its removal by flowing water.
Ground cover reduces raindrop impact and slows surface runoff, limiting erosion.
Removing vegetation can leave soil more vulnerable to erosion during heavy rain.
Read and write quorums that intersect can ensure a reader contacts a replica involved in the write.
For N replicas, choosing read and write quorum sizes whose sum exceeds N guarantees an intersection.
Quorum intersection alone is insufficient without rules for version selection and concurrent writes.
A version vector records counters from multiple replicas to represent causal history.
If neither version vector dominates the other, the updates are concurrent rather than causally ordered.
Version vectors help distinguish an obsolete replica value from a conflicting concurrent update.
Photosynthesis uses light energy to build chemical energy stores from carbon dioxide and water.
Chlorophyll absorbs light that drives photosynthetic reactions in plants.
Light availability can limit photosynthesis even when other inputs are present.
When a consumer is slower than a producer, an unbounded queue can grow until memory is exhausted.
Backpressure makes producers slow down or wait when bounded buffers fill.
A bounded queue with explicit overflow policy prevents silently unlimited buffering.
